name: Modified Moving Averages
summary: This EA trades based on modified moving average crossover signals, generating buy entries when a fast modified MA crosses above a slow modified MA and sell entries on the reverse crossover. It applies a modified moving average calculation that reduces lag compared to standard MAs, aiming for earlier trend detection and entry. The system includes basic risk parameters such as lot size, stop loss, and take profit for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于改良移动平均线的交叉信号进行交易，当快速改良MA上穿慢速改良MA时生成买入信号，反之下穿时生成卖出信号。它采用改良的移动平均计算方式以减少滞后性，旨在更早地检测趋势并入场。系统包含手数、止损和止盈等基本风险参数用于交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于改良移动平均线（MMA）的交叉，通过调整传统移动平均的计算方式减少滞后效应，从而更敏感地捕捉趋势转折。入场条件为快速MMA上穿慢速MMA时做多，快速MMA下穿慢速MMA时做空，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈值，当价格触及预设水平时平仓，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户通过参数设定每笔交易的手数，未涉及动态仓位调整或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面仅依靠止损止盈比例来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of modified moving averages (MMA), which adjusts the traditional moving average calculation to reduce lag and more sensitively capture trend reversals. Entry conditions generate a long position when the fast MMA crosses above the slow MMA and a short position on the reverse crossover, representing a classic trend-following approach. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit values that close positions when price reaches preset levels, and may also close on opposing crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach determined by user-configured parameters without dynamic sizing or percentage-based capital allocation. Money management relies solely on stop loss and take profit ratios to control per-trade risk, lacking comprehensive account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection mechanisms.

pros: 改良移动平均线减少了传统MA的滞后性，能更早捕捉趋势变化
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数较少，易于理解和优化
趋势跟踪策略在明显的单边行情中表现良好
固定止损止盈提供了基础的风险控制框架
信号生成基于技术指标交叉，具有一定的客观性和可重复性
pros_en: Modified moving averages reduce traditional MA lag, enabling earlier trend change detection
Strategy logic is simple and clear with few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
Trend-following strategy performs well in strong directional markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide a basic risk control framework
Signal generation based on indicator crossovers offers objectivity and repeatability
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户规模变化，风险控制不够灵活
缺乏整体账户级别的风险管理，如最大回撤限制或日亏损上限
改良MA虽然在滞后性上有所改善，但在市场噪音大时仍可能产生错误信号
未包含加仓、减仓或追踪止损等高级仓位管理功能
cons_en: Trend-following strategies are prone to frequent false signals and losses in ranging or choppy markets
Fixed lot position sizing does not adapt to account size changes, making risk control inflexible
Lacks account-level risk management such as maximum drawdown limits or daily loss caps
Although improved over standard MAs, modified MAs can still generate false signals in noisy market conditions
Does not include advanced position management features like scaling in/out or trailing stops
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡市中减少交易频率或暂停交易
实现基于账户权益百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数方式
加入追踪止损功能以在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加多时间周期确认机制，提高信号可靠性
添加最大回撤和连续亏损保护机制
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce trade frequency or pause trading in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage instead of fixed lots
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in more profit during trending moves
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability
Add maximum drawdown and consecutive loss protection mechanisms

risk_points: 固定手数仓位管理不随账户规模调整，可能在连续亏损时造成较大比例损失
缺乏账户级别的风险控制机制，如最大回撤限制
震荡行情中MA交叉策略频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
未检测新K线形成可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adjust with account size, potentially causing proportionally large losses during drawdowns
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits
MA crossover strategy generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No new bar detection may cause duplicate position openings on the same candle
